0.original: Ser Berengeoit strikes you as a man with a sizable chip upon his shoulder, and such men are often ready to spend handsomely.

1.original: Ser Berengeoit insists that one dark night, he slew a wounded dragon with a well-aimed shot from a ballista. Alas, without a trophy, none will call him aught but a fevered fool. Someone must find the carcass and bring back a bone.

2.original: To your mild surprise, you find a dead dragon on a gorge floor as the young knight insisted, and collect from it a fine bone. This trophy will mean more to Ser Berengeoit than all the fish in the Sea of Clouds.

3.original: Ser Berengeoit receives the dragon bone with something resembling ecstasy. If even half the knights of Ishgard are as covetous of a kill, there is little to stop the war from continuing to rage...

25.original: Deliver the dragon bone to Berengeoit.

48.original: Adventurer, how would you like to assist a dragonslayer? I put a bolt through a dragon while manning the ballistas overlooking the gorges. I saw its death throes, and then it plunged...

49.original: But nobody will believe me! I had not the time to collect a trophy before I was relieved, and they will not credit what they do not see!

50.original: The carcass is out there in the bottom of a gorge, just waiting to be claimed. I hear you can find <hex:021A020203>anything<hex:021A020103>, and I need a dragon bone to show the others!

53.original: Did you get my dragon bone? That was my <hex:021A020203>first<hex:021A020103> dragon, you know... It's <hex:021A020203>special<hex:021A020103>...

54.original: Yes! Yes! Dragon bone! Who's spinning yarns now, huh? By the Fury!

55.original: Berengeoit Dragonslayer, blessed in the eyes of Halone... I have <hex:021A020203>dreamed<hex:021A020103> of this. Do you realize that I shall be commended by the archbishop himself?
